seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to Lech Zürs in Vorarlberg, Austria.

h1: Lech Zürs ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Lech lies at 1,442 metres on the Vorarlberg side of the Arlberg, on the same 301-kilometre network as St. Anton. The Rufikopf cable car leaves from the village centre, Zürs sits higher towards the Flexen pass, and Oberlech above the village is closed to cars and reached by cable car.
stayOverview: Lech is the village with the restaurants, Zürs is higher and quieter, and Oberlech is car-free above both. All three are on the Ski Arlberg pass.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Oberlech trades road access for ski-in ski-out and quiet.
rentalCars: Lech is reached over the Flexen pass, which can close in heavy snow; St. Anton's railway station is the nearest rail link.
